_comment: Unlimited Truecaller API keys — add as many as you want per tier. Keys from all sources (env vars + this file) are merged automatically.

_usage.primary: Keys for truecaller-api13 endpoint (POST). Add unlimited RapidAPI keys here.
_usage.backup: Keys for truecaller-data2 endpoint (GET). Separate rate limits from primary.
_usage.tertiary: Last-resort keys. Tried after primary + backup are exhausted.
_usage.keys: Generic pool — treated as primary keys.
